Quick notes + my vote: 5\/10 (uploaded).

Reasoning: excellent systems depth on sharding/kv cache design — the implementation thought was solid. However, when pressed on tradeoffs for latency vs cost in a multi-tenant inference runtime they defaulted to heavy-handed approaches (more replication, stronger isolation) without demonstrating incremental mitigations or cost awareness. For the role (Platform — cost/latency-sensitive) that's a meaningful gap.

Given mixed signals I lean to either: (1) a focused 45-min follow-up on \"scaling a low-latency KV cache across regions\" (my recommended path) to give them a chance to surface pragmatic tradeoffs, OR (2) decline. If we want to keep momentum for hiring, option (1) is my pick.
